standard_prerequisites.name: The flat base change property G(B) tensor_B B' = G(B') for flat B -> B'
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes G(B) a subgroup of G(B') for the faithfully flat extension used.

core_obligations: Form the faithfully flat extension B' = B[x, y, x^-1, y^-1]/(x + y - b) and note G(B) embeds in G(B') (proof lines 766-770).
Write b = x + y with x, y units in B' and compute phi(b xi) by additivity and unit equivariance (proof lines 771-776).
Compare with b phi(xi) and conclude (proof lines 776-777).
proof_roadmap: The faithfully flat extension splitting b into two units (proof lines 766-770).
difficulty_reason: If a transformation phi : F -> G of module-valued functors on Alg_A is additive, commutes with multiplication by units of B, and G satisfies the flat base change property, then the lemma asserts that phi is a morphism of module-valued functors, i.e. respects the B-module structure (statement lines 749-762). The proof is short but entirely explicit: for b in B it forms the faithfully flat extension B' = B[x, y, x^-1, y^-1]/(x + y - b), so that G(B) is a subgroup of G(B'), writes b = x + y with x, y units in B', and computes phi(b xi) = phi((x+y) xi) = x phi(xi) + y phi(xi) = (x+y) phi(xi) = b phi(xi) (proof lines 764-777). The level is H3: the trick of adjoining two units summing to b is the whole content, and it is carried out completely, with the faithful flatness step named.
